repos_data.description: The Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Stack: Connecting Cutting-Edge AI Models and Agent Infra

Local MCP server that gives any AI agent safe desktop control on Windows, macOS and Linux. Reads the screen as text and structure (accessibility + OCR) and acts by element name, with screenshots as the last resort. Multi-monitor aware, verifies every action, one safety gate.
Give your AI agent eyes and hands on any desktop — cross-platform accessibility API with MCP server
Open-source Computer Use MCP server for any coding agent — macOS, Windows, Linux. Accessibility-first, background input, agent pointer, zoom, your signed-in Chrome.

Windows computer-use MCP server: drive any desktop app via semantic discover-then-act targeting (entities + leases, not pixel coordinates), with per-action perception guards, a native Rust UIA engine, Chrome CDP, and Key Locker credential autofill for ssh/sudo password prompts. Works with Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client.
Apache-2.0, model-agnostic macOS agent: bring your own model to deliver verified code, docs, slides, and computer actions.
Open-source desktop coding agent for macOS. Use any model: local with Ollama, your own API keys or a ChatGPT sign-in. Parallel chats, MCP connectors, skills, and computer use on a desktop of its own.
One browser shared by a human and an AI: visual for the human, source-level for the AI
Talk to your Mac and it does it — in any app, while you're still talking. Open-source voice agent that gets faster the more you use it.
Computer Experience Layer — MCP server for native computer use on macOS. Structured perception, reliable actions, continuous awareness.
Local MCP server and CLI for AI agents: read web pages and public APIs, triage GitHub Actions runs, check HTML pages, and control a browser or Windows apps after you grant access.

Point an app at two logged-in users and it finds the broken access control (IDOR). Deterministic browser perception + cross-identity authz testing for AI agents — drives your real Chrome over MCP or runs headless. Open-core, local, no account.
Let AI agents see and drive your Kasm Workspaces desktops over MCP.
Remote MCP server for Glasswarp — observe and control real Windows PCs
Full macOS control MCP server — drive a Mac like a human: shell, AppleScript, files, processes, and human-like GUI (click, drag, scroll, type). Full control by default; opt-in safe mode.
MCP server for AI hallucination detection & agent safety — verify claims, guard prompts, gate CUA actions
